topic: What payload transponder allocation strategies balance spectral efficiency with dynamic QoS demands from ML traffic classification?
consensus_response: Dynamic resource allocation, adaptive modulation and coding, beamforming, and hierarchical beamforming optimize spectral efficiency. ML-driven traffic classification prioritizes high-QoS traffic, while non-uniform quantization and beam hopping enhance resource utilization. Balancing these strategies ensures QoS guarantees and spectral efficiency in SatCom networks.
reference_context: QoS mechanisms interact between layer 3 and layer 2, classifying packets for joint qos provisioning.
